Noah R.: Quick flag: after enabling the v2 opt-in toggle for beta tenants some are reporting unexpected quota usage spikes. Console shows route=v2 but billing preview hasn't stabilized. Looks like older SDKs send X-Client-Version=1 by default, so we have mixed signals.

Tara W.: I pulled a sample and saw the same. The routing layer prefers explicit client header but also applies a runtime compatibility shim for requests without the header. When the shim runs it sets route=v1, but the downstream model router still records model_variant=v2 once the pipeline selects the faster model. Two keys for one request.

Owen C.: Can you paste the log lines?

Noah R.: Sure:
```
2025-03-20T11:02:12Z routing: tenant=acme-prod decision=compat_shim route=v1 trace=tr_5623 tokens=340
2025-03-20T11:02:12Z model-router: selected=model-v2-quant trace=tr_5623
```
So route=v1 but model=v2. Billing ETL groups by route *and* model_variant in different aggregates which causes the quota dashboard to show double consumption.

Marta Z.: UX risk: if tenants see doubled numbers they'll churn. Short-term: hide the quota impact row in the rollforward preview and mark "observability-only" until we canonicalize attribution. Long-term: add a single canonical header `X-Redwood-Serving` set at routing decision time (values: v1|v2|compat) and make all downstream systems read that first.

incident-bot: Created incident INC-2026-786 -> Duplicate attribution during v2 soft-launch (https://redwood/incidents/INC-2026-786)

Owen C.: Implementation plan:
- Routing: inject header `X-Redwood-Serving` at decision point.
- Proxy/model-router: stop writing model_variant to telemetry if header exists (or at least tag with `driven_by_header=true`).
- ETL: precedence rule: use `X-Redwood-Serving` for billing/quota keys; fall back to model_variant only if header missing.
Estimate: routing change + tests 4-6 hrs; model-router guard 2-3 hrs; ETL precedence + deploy 6 hrs incl small 1% validation backfill.

Tara W.: Also propose console enhancement: a "Sandbox billing" mode that runs the same preview but marks any attributed tokens as "not billed" and surfaces sample traces. This helps PMs and customers validate before flip. We should wire this to the preview API: /api/rollout/preview?billing=sandbox.

Noah R.: Good idea. For communication: we should default rollouts for older SDK cohorts to "shadow mode" where traffic goes to v2 but billing attribution remains v1 for 72h or until canonicalization is verified. That protects customers from surprises.

Marta Z.: Agreed. I'll draft the console copy and tenant notification. Also add an admin flag to the console to force strict-billing mode for tenants who explicitly opt-in.

Owen C.: Owners: Noah (routing header PR + tests), Tara (console sandbox + API), Owen (model-router guard + ETL precedence), Marta (comms + admin config). Ops-bot, please reserve a low-impact window for the 1% reprocess validation.

ops-bot: Noted. Scheduling 1% validation backfill tonight 01:30-02:00 UTC. Will page oncall if CPU > 65% or latency > 200ms.

Noah R.: I'll open PRs today and tag reviewers. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
